pr_title: ADR0133: complete Remote AI Studio first-release validation
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR0133 Remote AI Studio first-release validation from current main. Adds deterministic host-owned Remote state and actual Microsoft Edge capture of the production loopback companion at desktop, narrow, and mobile widths. Fixes the visual-validation scenario classification so the Remote helper bypasses generic authoring-tool lookup.

## Validation

Requires full Windows Validation because `scripts/ci/**` changes, Automation Regression, and ChatGPT visual review of the production Remote AI Studio screenshots.
